modals.settingsDescription: Customize the look and formatting of Caja.
modals.dataDescription: Save a copy of all your businesses to a file, or restore it on another computer. Everything stays on your computer.
modals.restoreWarning: Restoring replaces all current data with the backup. This can't be undone.
modals.newBusinessDescription: Each business keeps its own separate cash box.
modals.monthlyProfitGoalHint: Target balance per month in {{currency}}. Optional — shown in the Dashboard and Panel.
modals.carryOverDescription: Carries each month's final balance over to the next. It doesn't roll from one year to another.
modals.shareInfo: The PDF includes all 3 formats in a single file: single step, multiple steps, and monthly comparison.
modals.categoriesDescription: Group this table's expenses by category.
modals.categoryColumnHint: Choose which text column groups the rows in this table.
modals.recurringDescription: Rows that repeat every month in "{{name}}".
modals.noRecurringYet: No recurring rows for this table yet. Add one below.
modals.name: Name
modals.rangeHint: The end month must come after the start month.
modals.recurringNote: Recurring rows appear automatically every month in the range. You can edit or skip one in a specific month from the table.
